year of the zabal day 313

fractal week

ZAO Fractal 123 was set for tonight in [the ZAO discord](https://discord.thezao.com). at a fractal we go around and each of us shares what we did for the ZAO this week. the group ranks it together and the ranking earns Respect, the ZAO's contribution points. i am on vacation and only Metamu showed up for our monday fractal, thank you Metamu for showing up, and since we need a minimum of 4 people to start a fractal we were not able to play a fractal game tonight. still want in this week? join tomorrow around noon eastern with iman: [luma.com/lfdnyq7x](https://luma.com/lfdnyq7x)

last night dr bruce banner took the battle over nessy the rilla in 3 rounds. nessy took round 1. WaveWarZ is at 1,696 battles now and every number is on [wavewarz.info](https://wavewarz.info)

this weekend ZOE got 5 upgrades. /help in every chat. /idea cards from the devz group straight to the desk. read only github in our groups. /teamview to see a teammates open board rows. and a group memory so she remembers yesterday. all behind flags i flip this week. type /help in the ZAO devz chat and tell me what is missing. dm zaal if you want to join the ZAO devz chat

i am in florida with my fiancee's family until wednesday. slower week on purpose

p.s. my singapore bounty is still open at [poidh.xyz/base/bounty/1536](https://poidh.xyz/base/bounty/1536). back it and send me your questions about zoroastrianism
